Cosmati VERSION for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel, macOS 10.15 or later): Tessera as a plugin
================================================================================

In this folder:
  Cosmati.clap        the CLAP instrument (Bitwig, Reaper, ...)
  Cosmati.vst3        the VST3 instrument (Ableton Live, Cubase, ...)
  Cosmati.component   the Audio Unit (Logic Pro, GarageBand, MainStage)
  Cosmati.app         the standalone app: no DAW needed

Each runs natively on Apple silicon and on Intel Macs.

Install
-------
1. Copy each plugin to your own Plug-Ins folders (in Finder: Go > Go to Folder..., paste the path):
     Cosmati.clap       to  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP/
     Cosmati.vst3       to  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/
     Cosmati.component  to  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/
   (Make the CLAP folder if it isn't there.) Cosmati.app can go in Applications.
2. SIGNING (see below).
3. In your DAW, rescan the plugins. Cosmati is an instrument, under "Rastapopolix". Logic finds the
   Audio Unit under AU Instruments > Rastapopolix > Cosmati; if it doesn't, restart Logic, or the Mac.

Until beta 4 Cosmati was called Tessera: before step 2, delete Tessera.clap, Tessera.vst3 and
Tessera.component from those folders (and Tessera.app), so the DAW doesn't find it twice. Songs
saved with them open in Cosmati.

Signing: "damaged" or "can't be verified"
-----------------------------------------
SIGNING_NOTE

The manual for the plugin: https://github.com/Rastapopolix/tessera/blob/main/PLUGIN.md
What's in this beta, and what isn't yet: BETA_NOTES.md in this folder.
Found a problem? https://github.com/Rastapopolix/tessera/issues (the plugin's version, your DAW and its
version, macOS' version, Apple silicon or Intel, the steps, what you expected and what happened).
